mentions.description: A fast macOS-native Bible search app. It lays out all 31k verses in <10ms in a single scrollable window (tested on an M1 Pro MacBook) and re-filters/re-lays-out results in <6ms on each keystroke. It supports deep search syntax (ranges, quoting), lets users click an English word to search for verses containing the Greek, Hebrew, or Aramaic word it translates, matches OT verses via the Septuagint for a given Greek word, and includes built-in Greek and Hebrew lexicons that display entries for each original-language search term.
mentions.audience: Bible readers and students of biblical Greek and Hebrew who need fast, deep original-language search on macOS.
mentions.author: TimTheTinker
